<thought>All three subnetworks connect sequentially (subnet 1 ends at X1, subnet 2 starts at X1 and ends at X2, subnet 3 starts at X2 and ends at B). By keeping the original node names and renaming the resistor identifiers so they are unique across the whole circuit, we obtain a complete topology containing exactly the 10 resistors required.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 5.0, "R2": 10.0, "R3": 15.0, "R4": 20.0, "R5": 10.0, "R6": 15.0, "R7": 20.0, "R8": 20.0, "R9": 15.0, "R10": 10.0}, "connections": [["A","N_a1","R1"], ["N_a1","N_a2","R2"], ["N_a2","N_a3","R3"], ["N_a3","X1","R4"], ["X1","N_b1","R5"], ["N_b1","N_b2","R6"], ["N_b2","X2","R7"], ["B","N_c2","R8"], ["N_c2","N_c1","R9"], ["N_c1","X2","R10"]]}</final_answer>
